q: What size company do you usually work with?
a: Most clients sit between $5M and $150M in revenue with a marketing team of two to twenty. Below that a retainer rarely pays for itself, and we'll say so on the first call.

q: Do you take a percentage of ad spend?
a: No. Fees are flat and published. The moment our income scales with your budget we stop being able to tell you to spend less.

q: How fast does anything actually go live?
a: First campaigns ship inside thirty days of kickoff. The diagnostic runs in parallel with build, so you aren't paying for a month of slide decks.

q: Will we own the accounts and the creative?
a: Always. Ad accounts, pixels, source files and documentation sit in your workspace from day one. If you leave, nothing walks out with us.

q: Can you work alongside our in-house team?
a: That's the preferred version. Roughly half our engagements are designed to hand the system over within eighteen months, and we help you hire for it.
Retainers run on 60-day notice after an initial 90-day term. We'd rather end an engagement honestly than defend a plan that isn't earning.
